name: North Node
defines: The direction of growth — the unfamiliar territory you are being pushed towards.

signs.aries: Growth means acting without a consensus behind you, and tolerating being the one who went first and got it wrong.
signs.taurus: Growth means settling on something and staying with it, and finding out that steadiness is not the same as stagnation.
signs.gemini: Growth means asking rather than pronouncing, and letting a hundred small curiosities take the place of one grand certainty.
signs.cancer: Growth means admitting that you need people, and letting yourself be looked after instead of proving you can manage.
signs.leo: Growth means stepping forward as yourself rather than as a delegate of the group, and enjoying it without apologising.
signs.virgo: Growth means dealing with the specific thing in front of you instead of the whole of it at once.
signs.libra: Growth means making room for somebody else's terms, and discovering that compromise is not the same as defeat.
signs.scorpio: Growth means letting something end properly, and accepting depth and obligation where you would rather stay unentangled.
signs.sagittarius: Growth means trusting your own sense of the whole instead of gathering more information before you will commit.
signs.capricorn: Growth means taking responsibility in public, building something with your name on it, and no longer waiting to feel ready.
signs.aquarius: Growth means loosening your grip on being special, and finding out what you are worth among a group of equals.
signs.pisces: Growth means putting the checklist down and trusting what you cannot verify, your own intuition included.
